## Known gaps in this freeze (stated, not hidden)

1. **Not covered by one end-to-end orchestrator run.** The last full 20-stage run of
   `experiments/run_reproducible_m1.py` (`docs/e2e_reproduction_report.md`) predates four stages added
   afterward: `per_label_selection`, `scaling_memory`, `framing_evidence`, and the `latex_tables` /
   `figures` generators. Each was run and verified individually; none has been exercised inside one
   uninterrupted orchestrator pass since being added. A user decision (2026-09-21) was to freeze on
   the currently committed artifacts rather than re-run the full pipeline first.
2. **`data/m1_subsample_n500.csv` has no committed generator script.** It is a frozen input to Table
   7 row A (float→quantized error decomposition, `docs/error_decomposition.md`). It was identified by
   exact-match provenance as a seed-42 draw from the training split (`docs/leakage_and_threshold_audit.md`
   §C), not regenerated from a committed script. Per the guide §31, "no manual undocumented processing
   remains" is therefore not fully true of this one input; it is named here rather than silently ticked.

## Dataset provenance and cohort definition

MIMIC-IV-ED-derived cohort (**Proxy/Simulated** — not a clinical deployment or clinical validation
study). Cohort construction: `src/build_cohort.py`; feature construction: `src/features.py`; ATC
medication crosswalk: `data/atc_crosswalk.json` (frozen 2026-09-11 record of the live NLM RxNav API,
not byte-reproducible — see `.gitignore`'s comment on this exception). Label definitions: Elixhauser
comorbidity categories via Quan et al. 2005 ICD coding algorithms.
